text: 1、市场早间低开调整，双创指数均跌超3%。白酒股逆势拉升，皇台酒业3天2板。PCB概念股继续活跃，澳弘电子涨停创新高，金禄电子、天津普林、崇达技术等多股封板。创新药概念股盘中走强，百花医药、华北制药涨停。下跌方面，航运板块调整，中远海能、招商轮船跌停；煤炭板块下挫，昊华能源、兖矿能源跌超8%。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市超5000股飘绿，上午半天成交9897亿。午间收盘沪指跌1.98%，深成指跌2.78%，创业板跌3.42%。 2、板块概念方面，白酒、PCB、券商、创新药等板块逆势活跃；煤炭、油气、航运、半导体等板块领跌； 3、两市共438只个股上涨，3
text_en: 1. The market opened lower and corrected in the morning, with both dual-innovation indices falling more than 3%. Baijiu stocks bucked the trend, with Huangtai Liquor rising for the second time in three days. PCB concept stocks remained active, with Aohong Electronics hitting the limit up to a new high, while Jinhua Electronics, Tianjin Printronics, and Shennan Circuits also sealed the limit up. Innovative drug concept stocks strengthened during the session, with Baihua Pharmaceutical and North China Pharmaceutical hitting the limit up. On the downside, the shipping sector corrected, with COSCO Shipping Energy and China Merchants Energy Shipping hitting the limit down; the coal sector slumped, with Haohua Energy and Yankuang Energy falling more than 8%. Stocks generally declined, with more than 5,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets in the red, and half-day turnover of RMB 989.7 billion. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.98%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.78%, and ChiNext fell 3.42%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, baijiu, PCB, brokerages, and innovative drugs were active against the trend; coal, oil and gas, shipping, and semiconductors led the declines; 3.
